title: Hosts health
description: CPU, memory, disk, network and system health of the KernelCI hosts running node_exporter

list.name: rate
list.label: Rate window
list.description: node_exporter is scraped every 5m; keep this at 3x that or more

targets.expr: count(100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs", job=~"node_.*", $env, instance=~"($host):[0-9]+"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs", job=~"node_.*", $env, instance=~"($host):[0-9]+"}) > 85) or vector(0)

panels.title: Filling within 7d
panels.description: Filesystems whose free space, extrapolated linearly from the last day, reaches zero within a week

panels.title: Host summary
panels.description: One row per host. CPU and load are 5 minute averages; Fullest FS is the most used real filesystem on the host.

targets.expr: max by (host) (label_replace(node_load5{job=~"node_.*", $env, instance=~"($host):[0-9]+"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) / count by (host) (label_replace(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", job=~"node_.*", $env, instance=~"($host):[0-9]+"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*"))

max by (host) (label_replace(100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs", job=~"node_.*", $env, instance=~"($host):[0-9]+"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs", job=~"node_.*", $env, instance=~"($host):[0-9]+"}), "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*"))

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: Share of all vCPUs not idle

panels.title: Load5 per vCPU
panels.description: Above 1 means more runnable (or D-state) tasks than vCPUs

targets.expr: max by (host) (label_replace(node_load5{job=~"node_.*", $env, instance=~"($host):[0-9]+"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) / count by (host) (label_replace(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", job=~"node_.*", $env, instance=~"($host):[0-9]+"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*"))

panels.title: iowait and steal
panels.description: iowait: CPUs idle waiting for disk. steal: time the hypervisor gave our vCPUs to someone else

panels.title: CPU pressure (PSI)
panels.description: Share of time at least one task was waiting for a CPU

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: 100% minus MemAvailable (page cache that can be dropped counts as free)

panels.title: Memory pressure (PSI)
panels.description: Share of time at least one task was stalled on memory (reclaim, swap-in, thrashing)

panels.title: Filesystems
panels.description: Free in 7d extrapolates the last day of free space linearly; red means the filesystem fills up within a week at the current rate

targets.expr: max by (host, mountpoint) (label_replace(100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs", job=~"node_.*", $env, instance=~"($host):[0-9]+"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs", job=~"node_.*", $env, instance=~"($host):[0-9]+"}), "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*"))

panels.title: Disk utilisation
panels.description: Share of time the device had I/O in flight

panels.title: I/O pressure (PSI)
panels.description: Share of time at least one task was stalled on I/O

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{device!~"lo|docker.*|veth.*|br-.*|cni.*|flannel.*|cali.*", job=~"node_.*", $env, instance=~"($host):[0-9]+"}[$rate]) + rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{device!~"lo|docker.*|veth.*|br-.*|cni.*|flannel.*|cali.*", job=~"node_.*", $env, instance=~"($host):[0-9]+"}[$rate]) + rate(node_network_receive_drop_total{device!~"lo|docker.*|veth.*|br-.*|cni.*|flannel.*|cali.*", job=~"node_.*", $env, instance=~"($host):[0-9]+"}[$rate]) + rate(node_network_transmit_drop_total{device!~"lo|docker.*|veth.*|br-.*|cni.*|flannel.*|cali.*", job=~"node_.*", $env, instance=~"($host):[0-9]+"}[$rate])), "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")

panels.title: Conntrack table used
panels.description: New connections are dropped when this reaches 100%
